summary: No commenter in this proceeding recommended removing Managed Internal Broadband Services from the Eligible Services List, and every commenter who addressed hourly, ticket-based reimbursement opposed it. Funds For Learning agrees with the record and adds the program-wide measurement that no single applicant can supply, drawn from twelve consecutive funding years of E-rate data. MIBS is a small part of the program. In Funding Year 2025 it accounted for $38.7 million, 3.5 percent of Category Two an The comment discusses the importance of E-Rate funding for schools and libraries, and the concerns raised by stakeholders regarding administrative complexity and the need to maintain MIBS eligibility. The text discusses the current state of the MIBS (Managed Internal Broadband Service) program under the E-Rate program, including its cost, participation, and growth over time. It mentions that the program has been operating for several years and has seen an increase in applicants and the number of sites participating. The text also mentions that the program is cost-effective and should be maintained as is, without any changes.
